short_description: A cross-behind lunge that targets the glutes, outer hips and quads with a rotational emphasis.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot behind and across the other, lowering into a lunge.
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Alternate sides with each rep.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down on the working foot.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower with control each time.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast.
Don't rotate your hips excessively.
Don't let your front heel lift.

short_description: A single-leg heel raise that isolates the calf muscles and improves ankle stability.
how_to: Stand near a wall for balance, resting one hand lightly on it.
Lift one foot off the floor.
Press through the ball of your standing foot to raise your heel as high as you can.
Lower back down with control.
Complete all reps on one side, then switch.
correct: Keep your standing leg straight but not locked.
Rise as high as possible each rep.
Lower slowly and with control.
Keep your core engaged for balance.
mistakes: Don't rush the movement.
Don't lean heavily on the wall.
Don't let your ankle roll outward.
Don't shorten the range of motion.

short_description: An explosive squat jump that builds leg power in the quads, glutes and calves while raising the heart rate.
how_to: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat with your thighs roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive upward explosively and jump off the floor.
Land with soft knees and go straight into the next squat.
Maintain a steady rhythm throughout.
correct: Land softly.
Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down in the squat.
Keep your chest up throughout.
mistakes: Don't land hard.
Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast on the squat.
Don't hold your breath.

short_description: A modified push-up from the knees that builds chest, shoulder and tricep strength at a reduced load.
how_to: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Walk your hands forward slightly so your body forms a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to the start.
Keep your core engaged throughout.
correct: Keep your body straight from head to knees.
Keep your elbows controlled on the way down.
Keep your core engaged.
Lower until your chest nearly touches the floor.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't let your lower back sag.
Don't rush the movement.

short_description: A quadruped push-up variation from an all-fours position that introduces beginners to pressing movement.
how_to: Start on hands and knees with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back flat and your hips above your knees.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to the start.
Maintain a controlled pace throughout.
correct: Keep your body straight.
Keep your elbows controlled and pointing back.
Keep your back flat throughout.
Lower with control each rep.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't let your head drop toward the floor.
Don't arch your lower back.

short_description: A table-top push-up variation facing upward that targets the triceps, posterior shoulders and glutes.
how_to: Sit on the floor with your hands behind you and your knees bent.
Press into your hands and feet to lift your hips into a table-top position.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are extended.
Keep your hips lifted throughout the set.
correct: Keep your body straight.
Keep your elbows controlled on the way down.
Keep your hips raised throughout.
Keep your core engaged.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop to the floor between reps.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't let your shoulders shrug up.
Don't hold your breath.

short_description: A stationary lunge-stance squat that trains the quads, glutes and hip flexors one leg at a time.
how_to: Step one foot forward and one foot back into a split stance.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with control.
Drive through your front heel to return to the start.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down throughout.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower and raise at a steady pace.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast.
Don't lean heavily forward.
Don't let your front heel lift.

short_description: A push-up with feet elevated on a surface that shifts emphasis to the upper chest and front shoulders.
how_to: Place your feet on an elevated surface such as a bench or step.
Walk your hands out into a straight-body position.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Press back up to the start.
Keep your body straight throughout.
correct: Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Keep your elbows controlled on the way down.
Keep your core engaged.
Lower all the way until your chest nearly touches.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't let your lower back sag.
Don't shrug your shoulders at the top.

short_description: A bodyweight dip using a bench or chair that targets the triceps and anterior shoulders.
how_to: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands gripping the edge beside your hips.
Slide your hips forward off the bench.
Bend your elbows to lower yourself toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are extended.
Keep your back close to the bench throughout.
correct: Keep your body straight.
Keep your elbows controlled and pointing back.
Keep your back close to the bench.
Lower until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop too far below the bench.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't shrug your shoulders as you lower.
Don't lock your elbows at the top.

short_description: A flowing push-up that moves through a downward dog to an upward dog, building shoulder and chest strength with a spine stretch.
how_to: Start in a downward dog position with your hips high.
Lower your head toward the floor in an arc.
Sweep your chest through and press up into an upward dog.
Push your hips back up to downward dog to complete one rep.
Move smoothly through the arc each time.
correct: Keep your body straight during the pressing phase.
Keep your elbows controlled on the way down.
Keep your movements smooth and flowing.
Keep your core engaged throughout.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop in the upward phase.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't rush the arc.
Don't collapse into the lower back at the top of the sweep.
